response.justification: Despite extensive senior-level experience, the candidate lacks junior-level alignment: Java is only listed as a skill without project context, German is only basic (critical for client-facing insurance projects), and the resume portrays a senior/lead profile inconsistent with an entry-level role, raising concerns about fit, salary expectations, and team integration.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong open-source contributions and technical communication skills
Proven track record in agile practices, CI/CD, and test-driven development
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, not meeting required fluency
Overqualified with 10+ years of senior experience, misaligned with entry-level role
No demonstrated Java project experience despite listing it as a skill
